title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-isaac-murphy-2026-03-04
body:
Quick notes / running scratchpad - Monday 2026-03-04

Top priorities (today)
- 9:00–11:30 AM: outbound calling block (west coast list) — push for discovery or calendar
- 1:30–2:30 PM: follow-ups from last week's demos (3 hot opps)
- 3:00 PM: prep for Wed AE sync (demo notes + ask list)
- Finish qualification for 4 leads in SDR queue (update CRM)

Daily numbers to hit
- 40 dials, 25 connected attempts, 6 meaningful conversations, 2 scheduled meetings
- Touches: LinkedIn + email sequence step 2 after call if no connect

Call list (west coast focus)
1) Aurora Health - Contact: Priya Shah (VP Eng) — (415) 555-0138
   - Last: left voicemail 2026-03-02, mentioned latency concerns for inference pipelines
   - Ask: schedule 30m demo for redwood dedicated vs managed latency SLA. Goal: intro + identify infra owner
   - Next step: Email + 2-sentence note w/ benchmark screenshot. Send by 10:30 AM

2) Nomad Analytics - Contact: Carlos Rivera (Head of ML) — carlos@nomadanalytics.com
   - Last: quick product fit chat 2026-02-27, wants pricing ballpark for 100K tokens/day
   - Note: primary concern cost, asks about batching/quantization strategies
   - Next step: Share Optimize doc + invite to pricing discussion with AE (cc finance)

3) Beacon Retail - Contact: Laura Chen (CTO) — laura.chen@beaconretail.io
   - Last: demo 2026-03-01, liked streaming and function-calling example
   - Risk: procurement timeline unclear, needs security/compliance doc for SSO/KMS
   - Next step: send security one-pager + propose next meeting with Solutions Engineer (SE)

4) Arcadia Games - Contact: Mike Patel (Lead Dev) — Slack DM open
   - Quick: wants embed generation latency for live leaderboards
   - Action: run internal quick perf check w/ infra, ping infra team (Olivia) for 1-hr turnaround

Follow-ups (prioritized)
- HOT: Aurora Health — email + benchmark by 10:30 AM (see template below)
- HOT: Nomad Analytics — attach Optimize recommendations + pricing grid; loop AE Maya for 1:1
- Beacon Retail — secure docs + SE intro, include our SOC2 summary (attach PDF from drive)
- Arcadia Games — internal ask to infra/serving-runtime: "quick perf for embedding latency at 512-dim, 50 req/s" (tag Olivia)

Scripts / snippets to use
- Voicemail script (short): "Hi <name>, Isaac Murphy from Redwood Inference. Quick note — we have a short demo showing 3x better 99th-pt latency vs standard endpoints for streaming. Would love 15–20m to run through if you have availability this week. My calendar: <link>. Cheers."
- Quick intro email (post-call): "Thanks for taking the time. Per our chat, attached is a short benchmark and a one-pager on dedicated pools. If this looks interesting, can we book 30m next week? — Isaac"

Pipeline notes / qualification checklist (tick when done)
- [ ] Problem exists (clear latency/cost metric identified)
- [ ] Decision maker engaged (AE or Eng lead confirmed)
- [ ] Budget window (next 3 months / 3–6 months / no budget)
- [ ] Tech check (PKI/KMS/SSO requirement noted)
- [ ] Next step scheduled

Specific opps update
- Nomad Analytics: BANT = B(yes), A(unknown target), N(decision maker Eng), T(3 months). Next: pricing call w/ Maya
- Beacon Retail: Security doc requested — procurement likely Q2 end. Risk: multi-vendor RFP
- Aurora Health: Pilot ask — 8-week pilot with 2 endpoints. Need legal + SOW template. Create ticket: JIRA-GTM-321 (added)

Internal notes / reminders
- Attachments to send: small benchmark png, dedicated-one-pager.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf (find in shared_drives/product/hosted-api/assets)
- SE availability: check with Olivia for Wed/Thu afternoon for Beacon Retail demo
- Pricing: use Q2 discount band (10% startup) for deals <$50k ARR — confirm with Maya before committing

Meeting prep (Wed AE sync)
- Bring 3 asks: 1) define pilot SOW template, 2) decide guardrails for promotional pricing, 3) update for demo script (add embed latency slide)
- Add to agenda: quick wins from last week (2 demos, 1 scheduled pilot)

Scratch / brain dump
- Thought: package a "tiny pilot" template (2-week, low-cost) to reduce friction for startups — include success criteria around latency & cost. Good marketing asset for SDRs to push for meeting
- Idea: start running short A/B subject lines for email step 2: "Re: pilot for inference latency" vs "Quick pilot: 3x latency improvement" — track opens in outreach tool

Notes to self
- Update CRM after each touch (use tags: "sdr-2026-q1" and company stage)
- Pull outreach cadence report Fri EOD and flag any sequences with <5% replies

Templates (copy/paste)
- Benchmark email: "Hi <name>, attaching the 99th-pt latency chart from a recent pilot (similar stack). Happy to walk through results — would 20m tomorrow or Thurs work?"

---
End of scratchpad. Will clean up and move to Confluence if any of these become playbook content.
